description:
Lowe's product data: search, products by category, product details, item lookup by item number, model number or UPC, product reviews, and a store locator by US ZIP code. Prices, stock and pickup are per Lowe's store.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- search (required: query): Search
- products_by_category (required: category_id): Products By Category
- product_details (required: product_id): Product Details
- item_lookup (required: search): Item Lookup
- product_reviews (required: product_id): Product Reviews
- store_locator (required: zipcode): Store Locator

When to use: Use for Lowe's specifically. For Home Depot use realtime_homedepot_data.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: realtime_lowes_data
